findings.detail: The atom returned a 200 OK with an INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict for malformed input (type mismatch) instead of a 422 Unprocessable Entity error.

notes: The atom logic correctly identifies pass/fail/insufficient states and adheres to the serialization rules for the ratio. However, the malformed input case fails to trigger the required 422 HTTP status, indicating a lack of schema validation at the gateway/entry level.
